newsitem.title: USA: Tommy Lee alleged to rough up photographer.
newsitem.headline: Tommy Lee alleged to rough up photographer.

text.p: Sheriff's deputies were investigating Monday an incident outside Hollywood's trendy night club, the Viper Room, in which a photographer alleged he was pushed to the ground by Motley Crue drummer Tommy Lee, the husband of "Baywatch" star Pamela Anderson Lee.

"Early Sunday, the photographer approached the Lees who were surrounded by security (guards). He said (Tommy) Lee pushed him out of the way and pushed him to the ground and he complained of a back injury," a spokeswoman for the Los Angeles County Sheriff's office said Monday.
She said the photographer, Henry Trappler, was treated and relased from Cedars-Sinai hospital.
Deputies called to the Viper Room interviewed Trappler, who filed a battery report, the spokeswoman said.

The Lees had left the scene, she said, and would be interviewed by the sheriff's department, which would then decide whether to press charges against the 34-year-old drummer, who has played for the heavy metal band for 15 years.
His wife recently gave birth to the couple's first child.
